rule.name: Capacitor/Cordova Insecure HTTP Endpoint Usage
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a transport-security exception, insecure endpoint, or certificate-validation configuration. Resolve the effective policy and the connections it governs.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker on the network may read or alter affected traffic if sensitive data travels over cleartext or the connection accepts an untrusted server. Normal HTTPS endpoints and correctly implemented validation do not establish exposure.
rule.developer: Use HTTPS with normal certificate-chain and hostname verification. Remove permissive production callbacks and broad transport exceptions; restrict any justified exception to a documented, non-sensitive endpoint.
rule.reviewer: Review endpoint configurations and block cleartext transport in production. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Insecure Browser Plugin Usage
rule.rule_desc: The application opens an external browser or embedded-browser target. Determine how the destination and any URL-carried data are selected.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker-selected destination may support phishing or receive sensitive URL values if the application trusts unvalidated external navigation parameters.
rule.developer: Allowlist required destinations and schemes, keep credentials out of URLs, and use platform browser flows with verified callback handling for authentication.
rule.reviewer: Confirm URL validation and navigation restrictions are enforced. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Sensitive Data in Local Storage
rule.rule_desc: The application stores sensitive values or configures protection for persistent data. Determine the actual storage location, backup policy, and lock-state access restrictions.
rule.vuln_desc: An actor with access to unprotected application files, backups, or overly broad keychain access may recover credentials or private records and use them outside the intended trust boundary.
rule.developer: Use the platform credential or key store for secrets and appropriate authenticated encryption and file protection for private records. Minimize stored data, backup exposure, and lock-state accessibility.
rule.reviewer: Review storage key/value usage and verify sensitive data handling. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Ionic/Cordova Allow Navigation Wildcard
rule.rule_desc: A browser-origin or navigation policy permits a broad set of external origins or destinations. Identify the resources and privileged interfaces covered by the effective policy.
rule.vuln_desc: An untrusted site may read protected responses or invoke privileged interfaces if a permissive policy admits it and independent authentication or authorization does not prevent the operation.
rule.developer: Allow only required trusted origins and destinations. Validate origin and message schemas, handle credentials deliberately, and enforce access controls independently of the origin policy.
rule.reviewer: Review config.xml allowlist entries and CSP alignment. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
